content: Is Hizu he Idhanyag te Megbevayà

Migkaǥi is Nengazen te, “Uvey kew, sikiyu is langun he egkemezahan, su heini zed is wahig! Minsan wazè niw selapì, ne pemasa kew wey megkaan! Hendini kew en, pemasa kew te vinu wey ǥatas he wazè din bayad.

Maan is egastu kew te selapì niw te kenà egkekaan? Maan is egestuwen niw is menge suwildu niw te kenà ebpekahantey keniyu? Pemineg kew kediey, ne ebpekekaan kew te metaam he menge keenen ne egkahantey kew.
Uvey kew wey mebpemineg kediey su wey kew meuyag. Ebpekid-uyun a keniyu te wazà pidtemanan. Ibpeehè ku keniyu is gaǥew wey kebmetinumanen ku he insaad ku ki David.
Midhimu ku sikandin he pengulu te menge nasyun, ne pinaaǥi kandin impeehè ku kandan is gehem ku.

Ed-umawen niw is menge etew ziyà te menge nasyun he kenè niw zuma, ne egaangaan sikandan edhendiyà te keniyu su iyan a is Nengazen he Megbevayè niw, he Waǥas he Megbevayà te Israel mibeǥey keniyu te zengeg.”
Dangep kew ziyà te Nengazen ne umawa niw sikandin mintras wazè pa med-awà sikandin is edtavang keniyu.

Ipeengked en is menge lalung te kedlalunglalung, ne ipeengkezi kandan is mezaat he ked-isip-isip dan. Ipelikù en sikandan diyà te Nengazen he Megbevayè tew su egkehizuwan din sikandan wey ebpeseyluwen.
Migkaǥi is Nengazen te, “Is ked-isip-isip ku, ne kenà iring te keniyu he ked-isip-isip, ne is menge ulaula ku, ne kenà iring te keniyu he menge ulaula.
Su iring te nekediyù is langit wey tanà, ne meziyù is ked-isip-isip niw te kedì he ked-isip-isip wey meziyù daan is keniyu he menge paaǥi te kedì he menge paaǥi.

Is uzan wey is ayis ne ebpuun te langit, ne kenè en heini edlikù diyà emun kenè pa ebpekeveǥey te wahig kayi te kelibutan he ebpetuvù te menge pinemula he ebpekeveǥey te venì te menge ebpemula wey keenen te menge etew.
Ne iring daan keniyan is menge lalag he egkeǥiyen ku, kenà egkehimu he wazà kayi pulus, kekenà, edtumanen kayi is pelanu ku; edlampus heini para meulaula is tuyù te kebpetudtula ku kayi.

“Menge Israilihanen, awè kew ziyà te Babilonia he melipayen, ne egiyan ku sikiyu wey kenà mekeizi. Henduen be te egkanta tenged te utew kegkelipey is menge vuntud wey menge vuvungan, ne henduen be te ebpakpak is langun he menge kayu.

Edtuvù is menge kayu he sipris wey mirtu ziyà te edtuvuan guntaan te zuǥiyen he zezeisey he kayu. Tenged te kegkeul-ulaha kayi egkeveǥayan a te zengeg; egkehimu heini he tuus te kegkemekeǥeǥehem ku te wazà pidtemanan.”
